# Functions

To reduce code, we will generate some functions here. 
```{r, echo = F}
# function, to get the frequency of all genes, that can be found two or more times in the data sets
get_frequencies <- function(genes) {
  genes_freq <- as.data.frame(table(genes))
  names(genes_freq) <- c("Gene", "Freq")
  genes_freq <- genes_freq[order(genes_freq$Freq, decreasing = T), ]
  return(genes_freq)
}

# function, to get all genes, which exon eQTL SNPs are overlapping with a GWAS SNP
GetOverlaps <- function(gwas, genes, snps, category){
  res <- data.frame(Gene = "", Category = "")
  # check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap
  for (gene in genes) {
    if(sum(overlapsAny(snps[snps$gene_name == gene, ], gwas)) > 0){
      gene_gwas <- cbind(gene, category)
      colnames(gene_gwas) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      res <- rbind(res, gene_gwas)
    }
  }
  res <- res[res$Gene != "", ]  # remove empty first row
  return(res)
}

# function to load the PRS all score file, change the colnames into right order and return only IID and 0.01 PRS
GetPRS <- function(filename){
  all_scores <- suppressWarnings(fread(filename, stringsAsFactors = F))
  # set colnames right 
  names <- colnames(all_scores)[-1] # remove first colname and save all others
  all_scores$`1` <- NULL # remove last column with NAs
  colnames(all_scores) <- names # set right colnames
  # return only IID and PRS for 0.01
  score <- all_scores[, c("IID", "0.01")]
  return(score)  
}
```


# Load data

## Load Index and Overlap data

Here, we will load all necessary data files. Following files will be loaded:
1. Rare variants of index patients including all columns,
2. ABMS exon eQTS genes (gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID),
3. exon eQTL Genes (eeGenes, gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID) and
4. overlap genes of rare variants, ABMS eeQTS and eeGenes (gene symbol and Ensembl gene ID). 
```{r}
# 1. Rare variants of index patients
index <- readRDS(paste0(rdata_path, "/Index-patients_rare_variants_filtered.rds"))
# 2. ABMS eeQTS
eeqts <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/1_ABMS_eQTS_genes.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# 3. eeGenes
eegenes <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/2_exon_eQTL_genes.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
# 4. Overlap
overlap <- fread(paste0(overlap_path, "/4_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_rare.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

Then, we will check the number of found index-patient genes:

|      | Counts |
|------|------|
| Index (Mutations) | `r length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID")` |
| Index (Genes) | `r length(unique(index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` |

# Overlaps to other resources

## Own data 

Before, we can do the overlaps, we need to remove the endings from the Ensembl gene IDs from the eGenes.
```{r, echo = F}
# for all eGenes remove endings from the Ensembl Gene IDs for the overlap to CMC
geGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_gene$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(geGenes)
teGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_transcript$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(teGenes)
eeGenes <- unique(as.vector(sapply(unlist(strsplit(eqtls_exon$`Ensembl Gene ID`, "\\|")), function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1])))
length(eeGenes)
```

Now, we can check all the overlaps to the index dataset:

|      | Index |
|------|------|
| tDEGenes | `r length(intersect(tDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` |
| eDEGenes | `r length(intersect(eDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(eDEGenes$"Ensembl Gene ID", index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| geGenes | `r length(intersect(geGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(geGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| teGenes | `r length(intersect(teGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(teGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| eeGenes | `r length(intersect(eeGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(eeGenes, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| ADHD eQTS | `r length(intersect(adhd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(adhd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| ASD eQTS | `r length(intersect(asd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(asd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| BD eQTS | `r length(intersect(bd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(bd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| CDG eQTS | `r length(intersect(cdg, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(cdg, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| MDD eQTS | `r length(intersect(mdd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(mdd, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |
| SCZ eQTS | `r length(intersect(scz, index$"Ensembl Gene ID"))` (`r round(length(intersect(scz, index$"Ensembl Gene ID")) / (length(index$"Ensembl Gene ID") / 100), digits = 2)`%) |

# Figures

## Rare variants of index patients dataset

### Barplot of variants per patient

```{r, echo = F}
# And we will plot the rare variants frequency:
# get frequency for each gene ID
index_new <- as.data.table(index)[, c("PatientID", "Ensembl.Gene.ID")]
index_freq <- get_frequencies(index_new$Ensembl.Gene.ID)

# Generate barplot
pdf(file = paste0(out_path, "/1_barplot_rare_variants_index-patients_gene_counts.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
barplot(table(index_freq$Freq), xlab = "Frequency", ylab = "# genes with this frequency", col = "black", cex.axis = 1.5, lwd = 2, cex.names = 1.5, cex.lab = 2, cex.main = 2)
dev.off()
barplot(table(index_freq$Freq), xlab = "Frequency", ylab = "# genes with this frequency", col = "black", cex.axis = 1.5, lwd = 2, cex.names = 1.5, cex.lab = 2, cex.main = 2)
```

## Barplot of FUMA results

First we need to load the dataset and filter it for FDR < 0.05:
```{r, echo = F}
# Load FUMA GS file for the rare variants of index patients
index_fuma <-fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/3.2_rare_variants_index/GS.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
index_fuma <- index_fuma[index_fuma$Category == "3_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt", ]
index_fuma <- index_fuma[index_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for geGenes (cases and controls): ", dim(index_fuma)[[1]][1]))

index_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(index_fuma$adjP)
index_fuma$GeneSet <- factor(index_fuma$GeneSet, levels = index_fuma$GeneSet[order(index_fuma$log_adjP)])

# Generate barplot
g <- ggplot(index_fuma, aes(y = log_adjP, x = GeneSet)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylab(bquote("-log"["10"]*"(adjP)")) +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle("Index: KEGG pathways") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01)) +
```

## Circular plot

Then, we generated a circular plot to see where the 832 genes are located on the genome, e.g. which chromosomes. 
```{r}
# Load Gencode gtf file to get the gene locations
gencode <- import.gff("/lustre/groups/ccm01/datasets/2018_MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/annotation_files/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", format = "gtf")
gencode <- gencode[gencode$gene_type == "protein_coding"]  # get only protein-coding genes
gencode <- gencode[gencode$source == "HAVANA"] # get only HAVANA source data
genes <- as.data.frame(gencode[gencode$type == "gene"])  # get only genes (no exons, cds, transcripts etc.)
genes <- genes[, c("gene_id", "seqnames", "start", "end")]
rm(gencode)

# For the overlap to the core gene set, we need to remove the endings from the Ensembl Gene IDs
genes$gene_id <- as.vector(sapply(genes$gene_id, function(x) strsplit(x, "\\.")[[1]][1]))

# Now, we can get the location for the core genes
core_genes <- genes[genes$gene_id %in% overlap$`Ensembl Gene ID`, ]

# Set the tracks
tracklist = BioCircosArcTrack('coreGenes', core_genes$seqnames, core_genes$start, core_genes$end, colors = "darkblue", labels = core_genes$gene_id, maxRadius = 0.97, minRadius = 0.83)
#maxRadius = 0.97, minRadius = 0.83  <- tracks shown in inner circle
#minRadius = 1.18, maxRadius = 1.25  <- tracks shown in outer circle

# get the chrosomose lengths for hg19 without the X and Y chromosomes
hg19_without_x = list("1" = 249250621, "2" = 243199373, "3" = 198022430, "4" = 191154276, "5" = 180915260, "6" = 171115067, "7" = 159138663, "8" = 146364022, "9" = 141213431, "10" = 135534747, "11" = 135006516, "12" = 133851895, "13" = 115169878, "14" = 107349540, "15" = 102531392, "16" = 90354753, "17" = 81195210, "18" = 78077248, "19" = 59128983, "20" = 63025520, "21" = 48129895, "22" = 51304566)

# Display the BioCircos visualization
BioCircos(tracklist, 
          genome = hg19_without_x,
          yChr = FALSE, 
          xChr = FALSE,
          genomeFillColor = viridis(23, direction = -1, end = 0.9), 
          chrPad = 0.02, 
          displayGenomeBorder = FALSE, 
          genomeTicksDisplay = FALSE,
          genomeTicksLen = 3,
          genomeTicksTextSize = 0,
          genomeTicksScale = 50000000,
          genomeLabelTextSize = "10pt",
          genomeLabelDy = -1)

```


## Barplot of FUMA results

First we need to load the dataset and filter it for FDR < 0.05:
```{r, echo = F}
# Load FUMA GS file for the overlap dataset
overlap_fuma <- fread(paste0(fuma_path, "/3.3_overlap_rare_eeGenes_eQTS/GS.txt"), header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
overlap_fuma <- overlap_fuma[overlap_fuma$Category == "3_kegg_entrez_no_disease_pathways.txt", ]
overlap_fuma <- overlap_fuma[overlap_fuma$adjP < 0.05, ]
print(paste0("Significant gene sets for overlap (eeGenes, ABMS eeQTS, index): ", dim(overlap_fuma)[[1]][1]))

overlap_fuma$log_adjP <- -log10(overlap_fuma$adjP)
overlap_fuma$GeneSet <- factor(overlap_fuma$GeneSet, levels = overlap_fuma$GeneSet[order(overlap_fuma$log_adjP)])

# Generate Barplot
g <- ggplot(overlap_fuma, aes(y = log_adjP, x = GeneSet)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylab(bquote("-log"["10"]*"(adjP)")) +
    xlab("") +
    ggtitle(paste0("KEGG gene sets of core set (N = ", length(overlap$`Gene Symbol`), ")")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.01)) +
    theme(axis.ticks = element_line(colour = NA), text = element_text(size = 16), panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(colour = "grey"), strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/2_barplot_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_index_top_KEGG_pathways.pdf"), width = 11, height = 12)
g
dev.off()
```

## Heatplot of top pathway genes

First, we need to get the genes of the top pathways.
```{r, echo = F}
kegg_genes <- overlap_fuma[, c("GeneSet", "genes")]
kegg_genes <- separate_rows(kegg_genes, genes, sep = ":")
genes <- unique(kegg_genes[kegg_genes$GeneSet %in% c("ECM-receptor interaction", "Focal adhesion"), ]$genes)
length(genes)
```

Then, we will generate the dataset, which we need to generate the heatplot. Therefore, we need three columns, with column 1 including the gene name and column 2 the ID or type the gene is found in, e.g. the pathway, eeGenes, etc.
```{r, echo = F}
# We will start with the three pathways:
plotting_data <- kegg_genes[kegg_genes$GeneSet %in% c("ECM-receptor interaction", "Focal adhesion"), ]
plotting_data <- plotting_data[, c("genes", "GeneSet")]
colnames(plotting_data) <- c("Gene", "Category")
plotting_data$Category <- factor(plotting_data$Category, levels = c("ECM-receptor interaction", "Focal adhesion"))
# Then, we add the eDEGenes
eDEGenes_new <- as.data.frame(eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, "Gene Symbol"])
colnames(eDEGenes_new) <- "Gene"
eDEGenes_new$Category <- "Exon-level differentially expressed genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, eDEGenes_new)
# Then, we add the tDEGenes => no hit
tDEGenes_new <- as.data.frame(tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, "Gene Symbol"])
# Then, we add the geGenes
geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[eqtls_gene$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, "Gene Symbol"])
colnames(geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
geGenes_new$Category <- "Gene eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the teGenes => no hit
teGenes_new <- as.data.frame(unique(eqtls_transcript[eqtls_transcript$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, "Gene Symbol"]))
colnames(teGenes_new) <- "Gene"
teGenes_new$Category <- "Transcript eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, teGenes_new)
# Then, we add the eeGenes => all hits
eeGenes_new <- as.data.frame(unique(eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, "Gene Symbol"]))
colnames(eeGenes_new) <- "Gene"
eeGenes_new$Category <- "Exon eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, eeGenes_new)
# Then, we add the ADHD eeQTS genes => no hit
adhd_new <- as.data.frame(adhd_symbols[adhd_symbols %in% genes])
# Then, we add the BD eeQTS genes => no hit
bd_new <- as.data.frame(bd_symbols[bd_symbols %in% genes])
# Then, we add the MDD eeQTS genes
mdd_new <- as.data.frame(mdd_symbols[mdd_symbols %in% genes])
colnames(mdd_new) <- "Gene"
mdd_new$Category <- "MDD exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, mdd_new)
# Then, we add the CDG eeQTS genes
cdg_new <- as.data.frame(cdg_symbols[cdg_symbols %in% genes])
colnames(cdg_new) <- "Gene"
cdg_new$Category <- "CDG exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, cdg_new)
# Then, we add the SCZ eeQTS genes
scz_new <- as.data.frame(scz_symbols[scz_symbols %in% genes])
colnames(scz_new) <- "Gene"
scz_new$Category <- "SCZ exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, scz_new)
# Then, we add the ABMS exon eQT-Score genes
abms_new <- rbind(adhd_new, bd_new, mdd_new, scz_new)
abms_new$Category <- "Joint exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, abms_new)
# Then, we add the CMC gDEGenes/isoDEGene (same hit in both)
#cmc_gDEGenes_new <- as.data.frame(cmc_gDEGenes[cmc_gDEGenes %in% genes])
#colnames(cmc_gDEGenes_new) <- "Gene"
#cmc_gDEGenes_new$Category <- "CMC g/isoDEGene"
#plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, cmc_gDEGenes_new)
# Then, we add the CMC geGenes
cmc_geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(cmc_geGenes[cmc_geGenes %in% genes])
colnames(cmc_geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
cmc_geGenes_new$Category <- "CMC gene eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, cmc_geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the CMC seGenes/isoeGenes
cmc_seGenes_new <- as.data.frame(cmc_seGenes[cmc_seGenes %in% genes])
colnames(cmc_seGenes_new) <- "Gene"
cmc_seGenes_new$Category <- "CMC isoform eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, cmc_seGenes_new)
# Then, we add the GTEx geGenes
gtex_geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(gtex_geGenes[gtex_geGenes %in% genes])
colnames(gtex_geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
gtex_geGenes_new$Category <- "GTEx gene eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gtex_geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the GTEx seGenes
gtex_seGenes_new <- as.data.frame(gtex_seGenes[gtex_seGenes %in% genes])
colnames(gtex_seGenes_new) <- "Gene"
gtex_seGenes_new$Category <- "GTEx splice eGenes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gtex_seGenes_new)
# Then, we add the SCZ GWAS loci genes => no hit
scz_gwas <- as.data.frame(scz_gwas[scz_gwas %in% genes])
# Then, we add the single nuclei data
colnames(cell_types) <- c("Gene", "Category")
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, cell_types)
# Then, we add the rare variants of index patient
rare_new <- as.data.frame(index[index$GeneSymbol %in% genes]$GeneSymbol)
colnames(rare_new) <- "Gene"
rare_new$Category <- "Rare variant genes"
plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, rare_new)
```

Get the eQTL SNPs for the 28 hit genes:
```{r, echo = F}
# get SNPs per gene from exon eQTL hits
genes_eesnps <- eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% genes, c("SNP", "SNP Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
genes_eesnps <- genes_eesnps[!duplicated(genes_eesnps), ]  # remove duplicated rows
genes_eesnps$CHR <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]))
genes_eesnps$POS <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2]))
# generate GRanges object
genes_eesnps_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = genes_eesnps$CHR, 
                                           ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS)), 
                                                                     end = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS))),
                                           snp_id = genes_eesnps$SNP, 
                                           gene_id = genes_eesnps$`Ensembl Gene ID`,
                                           gene_name = genes_eesnps$`Gene Symbol`)
# remove duplicates
genes_eesnps_gr <- genes_eesnps_gr[!duplicated(genes_eesnps_gr)] 
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(genes_eesnps_gr) <- "NCBI"
# get table how many SNPs we have for each gene
table(genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name)
rm(genes_eesnps)
```

Add VEP hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load VEP
vep <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/VEP_hg19_collapsed_MAF01.rds"))
states <- c("synonymous_variant_d", "stop_gained_d", "splice_region_variant_d", "promoter_d", "missense_variant_d", "3_prime_UTR_variant_d", "5_prime_UTR_variant_d")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap
 for (gene in genes) {
   for (state in states) {
     vep_selected <- vep[vep$code == state]
     if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], vep_selected)) > 0){
       gene_vep <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_d$")[[1]][1])
       colnames(gene_vep) <- c("Gene", "Category")
       plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gene_vep)
     }
   }
 }
```

Add ChromHMM hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load ChromHMM
chromhmm <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/ChromHMM_all_Brains.rds"))
states <- c("1_TssA", "2_TssAFlnk", "3_TxFlnk", "4_Tx", "5_TxWk", "6_EnhG", "7_Enh", "8_ZNF/Rpts", "10_TssBiv", "11_BivFlnk", "13_ReprPC")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap => if yes, save it
for (gene in genes) {
  for (state in states) {
    chromhmm_selected <- chromhmm[chromhmm$name == state]
    if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], chromhmm_selected)) > 0){
      gene_chromhmm <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_")[[1]][2])
      colnames(gene_chromhmm) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      plotting_data <- rbind(plotting_data, gene_chromhmm)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r, echo = F}
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 9), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), strip.background = element_rect(
     color = "black", fill = viridis(3, option = "D", begin = 0.15, end = 0.9)[2], size = 1.5, linetype = "solid"
     ), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
     panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black")) +
  xlab("rs11373481") + ylab("Exon expression") + ggtitle("LAMA4: ENSE00000762309 - rs11373481")
```


## Heatplot of top cell type genes

First, we need to get the genes of the cell types with the highest mean expression values (mean expr. per gene > 4).
```{r, echo = F}
ct_genes <- unique(ct_genes)
head(ct_genes)
genes <- top_hits[, c("Gene Symbol", "Ensembl Gene ID")]
genes2 <- genes[genes$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, ]
write.table(genes2, file = paste0(out_path, "/28_KEGG_pathway_genes.tsv"), row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
rm(genes, genes2)
```

Then, we will generate the dataset, which we need to generate the heatplot. Therefore, we need three columns, with column 1 including the gene name and column 2 the ID or type the gene is found in, e.g. the pathway, eeGenes, etc.
```{r, echo = F}
# We will start with the three pathways:
plotting_data2 <- kegg_genes[kegg_genes$genes %in% ct_genes, ]
plotting_data2 <- plotting_data2[, c("genes", "GeneSet")]
colnames(plotting_data2) <- c("Gene", "Category")
# Then, we add the eDEGenes
eDEGenes_new <- as.data.frame(eDEGenes[eDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, "Gene Symbol"])
colnames(eDEGenes_new) <- "Gene"
eDEGenes_new$Category <- "Exon-level differentially expressed genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, eDEGenes_new)
# Then, we add the tDEGenes => no hit
tDEGenes_new <- as.data.frame(tDEGenes[tDEGenes$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, "Gene Symbol"])
# Then, we add the geGenes
geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(eqtls_gene[eqtls_gene$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, "Gene Symbol"])
colnames(geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
geGenes_new$Category <- "Gene eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the teGenes => no hit
teGenes_new <- as.data.frame(unique(eqtls_transcript[eqtls_transcript$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, "Gene Symbol"]))
colnames(teGenes_new) <- "Gene"
teGenes_new$Category <- "Transcript eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, teGenes_new)
# Then, we add the eeGenes => all hits
eeGenes_new <- as.data.frame(unique(eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, "Gene Symbol"]))
colnames(eeGenes_new) <- "Gene"
eeGenes_new$Category <- "Exon eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, eeGenes_new)
# Then, we add the ADHD eeQTS genes => no hit
adhd_new <- as.data.frame(adhd_symbols[adhd_symbols %in% ct_genes])
# Then, we add the BD eeQTS genes => no hit
bd_new <- as.data.frame(bd_symbols[bd_symbols %in% ct_genes])
# Then, we add the MDD eeQTS genes
mdd_new <- as.data.frame(mdd_symbols[mdd_symbols %in% ct_genes])
colnames(mdd_new) <- "Gene"
mdd_new$Category <- "MDD exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, mdd_new)
# Then, we add the CDG eeQTS genes
cdg_new <- as.data.frame(cdg_symbols[cdg_symbols %in% ct_genes])
colnames(cdg_new) <- "Gene"
cdg_new$Category <- "CDG exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, cdg_new)
# Then, we add the SCZ eeQTS genes
scz_new <- as.data.frame(scz_symbols[scz_symbols %in% ct_genes])
colnames(scz_new) <- "Gene"
scz_new$Category <- "SCZ exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, scz_new)
# Then, we add the ABMS exon eQT-Score genes
abms_new <- rbind(adhd_new, bd_new, mdd_new, scz_new)
abms_new$Category <- "Joint exon eQT-Score genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, abms_new)
# Then, we add the CMC geGenes
cmc_geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(cmc_geGenes[cmc_geGenes %in% ct_genes])
colnames(cmc_geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
cmc_geGenes_new$Category <- "CMC gene eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, cmc_geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the CMC seGenes/isoeGenes
cmc_seGenes_new <- as.data.frame(cmc_seGenes[cmc_seGenes %in% ct_genes])
colnames(cmc_seGenes_new) <- "Gene"
cmc_seGenes_new$Category <- "CMC isoform eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, cmc_seGenes_new)
# Then, we add the GTEx geGenes
gtex_geGenes_new <- as.data.frame(gtex_geGenes[gtex_geGenes %in% ct_genes])
colnames(gtex_geGenes_new) <- "Gene"
gtex_geGenes_new$Category <- "GTEx gene eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, gtex_geGenes_new)
# Then, we add the GTEx seGenes
gtex_seGenes_new <- as.data.frame(gtex_seGenes[gtex_seGenes %in% ct_genes])
colnames(gtex_seGenes_new) <- "Gene"
gtex_seGenes_new$Category <- "GTEx splice eGenes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, gtex_seGenes_new)
# Then, we add the SCZ GWAS loci genes => no hit
scz_gwas_new <- as.data.frame(scz_gwas[scz_gwas %in% ct_genes])
# Then, we add the single nuclei data
cts2 <- cts[cts$names %in% ct_genes, c("names", "Type")]
colnames(cts2) <- c("Gene", "Category")
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, cts2)
# Then, we add the rare variants of index patient
rare_new <- as.data.frame(index[index$GeneSymbol %in% ct_genes]$GeneSymbol)
colnames(rare_new) <- "Gene"
rare_new$Category <- "Rare variant genes"
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, rare_new)
```

Get the eQTL SNPs for the 20 hit genes:
```{r, echo = F}
# get SNPs per gene from exon eQTL hits
genes_eesnps <- eqtls_exon[eqtls_exon$`Gene Symbol` %in% ct_genes, c("SNP", "SNP Location", "Ensembl Gene ID", "Gene Symbol")]
genes_eesnps <- genes_eesnps[!duplicated(genes_eesnps), ]  # remove duplicated rows
genes_eesnps$CHR <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]))
genes_eesnps$POS <- unlist(lapply(genes_eesnps$`SNP Location`, function(x) strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2]))
# generate GRanges object
genes_eesnps_gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(seqnames = genes_eesnps$CHR, 
                                           ranges = IRanges::IRanges(start = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS)), 
                                                                     end = as.numeric(as.character(genes_eesnps$POS))),
                                           snp_id = genes_eesnps$SNP, 
                                           gene_id = genes_eesnps$`Ensembl Gene ID`,
                                           gene_name = genes_eesnps$`Gene Symbol`)
# remove duplicates
genes_eesnps_gr <- genes_eesnps_gr[!duplicated(genes_eesnps_gr)] 
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(genes_eesnps_gr) <- "NCBI"
# get table how many SNPs we have for each gene
table(genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name)
rm(genes_eesnps)
```

Add VEP hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load VEP
vep <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/VEP_hg19_collapsed_MAF01.rds"))
states <- c("synonymous_variant_d", "stop_gained_d", "splice_region_variant_d", "promoter_d", "missense_variant_d", "3_prime_UTR_variant_d", "5_prime_UTR_variant_d")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap
 for (gene in ct_genes) {
   for (state in states) {
     vep_selected <- vep[vep$code == state]
     if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], vep_selected)) > 0){
       gene_vep <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_d$")[[1]][1])
       colnames(gene_vep) <- c("Gene", "Category")
       plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, gene_vep)
     }
   }
 }
```

Add ChromHMM hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load ChromHMM
chromhmm <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/ChromHMM_all_Brains.rds"))
states <- c("1_TssA", "2_TssAFlnk", "3_TxFlnk", "4_Tx", "5_TxWk", "6_EnhG", "7_Enh", "8_ZNF/Rpts", "10_TssBiv", "11_BivFlnk", "13_ReprPC")
# check for each gene and each state if there is any overlap => if yes, save it
for (gene in ct_genes) {
  for (state in states) {
    chromhmm_selected <- chromhmm[chromhmm$name == state]
    if(sum(overlapsAny(genes_eesnps_gr[genes_eesnps_gr$gene_name == gene, ], chromhmm_selected)) > 0){
      gene_chromhmm <- cbind(gene, strsplit(state, "_")[[1]][2])
      colnames(gene_chromhmm) <- c("Gene", "Category")
      plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, gene_chromhmm)
    }
  }
}
```

Add GWAS hits:
```{r, echo = F}
# load SCZ2-2014 and add genes with overlapping SNPs to the plotting dataset
scz_gr <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/GWAS_sumstats_SCZ2-2014_p0.05.rds"))
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, GetOverlaps(gwas = scz_gr, genes = ct_genes, snps = genes_eesnps_gr, category = "SCZ"))

# load MDD3-2019 and add genes with overlapping SNPs to the plotting dataset
mdd3_gr <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/GWAS_sumstats_MDD3-2019_p0.05.rds"))
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, GetOverlaps(gwas = mdd3_gr, genes = ct_genes, snps = genes_eesnps_gr, category = "MDD"))

# load CDG2-2019 and add genes with overlapping SNPs to the plotting dataset
cdg_gr <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/GWAS_sumstats_CDG2-2019_p0.05.rds"))
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, GetOverlaps(gwas = cdg_gr, genes = ct_genes, snps = genes_eesnps_gr, category = "CDG"))

# load BD-2019 and add genes with overlapping SNPs to the plotting dataset
bd_gr <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/GWAS_sumstats_BIP-2019_p0.05.rds"))
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, GetOverlaps(gwas = bd_gr, genes = ct_genes, snps = genes_eesnps_gr, category = "BD"))

# load ADHD-2019 and add genes with overlapping SNPs to the plotting dataset
adhd_gr <- readRDS(paste0(rds_path, "/GWAS_sumstats_ADHD-2019_p0.05.rds"))
plotting_data2 <- rbind(plotting_data2, GetOverlaps(gwas = adhd_gr, genes = ct_genes, snps = genes_eesnps_gr, category = "ADHD"))
```

Finally, we can generate the heatplot using ggplot:
```{r, echo = F}
# order plotting data on category and genes with most hits
#plotting_data2$Category <- factor(plotting_data2$Category, levels = names(table(plotting_data2$Category)[order(table(plotting_data2$Category), decreasing = T)]))
plotting_data2$Gene <- factor(plotting_data2$Gene, levels = c("ANK1", "GAD1", "DLGAP1", "SDK1", "BTBD11", "NRXN3", "ROBO2", "GRID2", "PCDH15", "PAM", "GAD2", "DPP10", "RYR1", "DLGAP2", "COL12A1", "TENM4", "TENM2", "PACRG", "RIMS2", "CIT", "CSMD1", "ATP10B", "USP24", "DOCK1", "TNK2", "DGKG", "KIF13A", "DGKD", "EPHA6"))
#plotting_data2$Gene <- factor(plotting_data2$Gene, levels = names(table(plotting_data2$Gene)[order(table(plotting_data2$Gene), decreasing = T)]))
plotting_data2$Category <- factor(plotting_data2$Category, levels = c("Phosphatidylinositol signaling system", "Metabolic pathways", "GABAergic synapse", "Focal adhesion", "Circadian entrainment", "Calcium signaling pathway", "Exon eGenes", "Transcript eGenes", "Gene eGenes", "Exon-level differentially expressed genes", "SCZ exon eQT-Score genes", "MDD exon eQT-Score genes", "CDG exon eQT-Score genes", "Joint exon eQT-Score genes", "Rare variant genes", "CMC isoform eGenes", "CMC gene eGenes", "GTEx splice eGenes", "GTEx gene eGenes", "Oligodendrocyte precursor cells", "Inhibitory VIP neurons", "Inhibitory SST neurons, cluster 1", "Inhibitory PVALB neurons, cluster 2", "Inhibitory PVALB neurons, cluster 1", "synonymous_variant", "3_prime_UTR_variant", "missense_variant", "promoter", "5_prime_UTR_variant", "ZNF/Rpts", "TxWk", "TxFlnk", "Tx", "ReprPC", "BivFlnk", "TssAFlnk", "EnhG", "Enh", "TssBiv", "TssA", "SCZ", "MDD", "CDG", "BD", "ADHD"))
g <- ggplot(plotting_data2, aes_(~Gene, ~Category)) +
  geom_tile(aes(width = 0.9, height = 0.9), color = "white") + 
  xlab(NULL) + 
  ylab(NULL) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 60, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")) + 
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.03, 0)) 
ggsave(plot = g, file = paste0(out_path, "/2_heatplot_overlap_eeGenes_ABMS_index_top_cell_type_genes.pdf"), width = 11, height = 12)
g
dev.off()
```

## STRING DB network

First we need to load STRINGdb -> R version too old (I generated the figure on my laptop instead as I updated R to version 4.)
```{r}
library(STRINGdb)
library(igraph)

# load human STRING network (Human = 9606, Mouse = 10090)
string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version="11", species=9606, score_threshold=200, input_directory="")
# first we need to map the gene IDs to STRING IDs
ct_genes_mapped <- string_db$map(as.data.frame(ct_genes), "ct_genes", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)
hits <- ct_genes_mapped$STRING_id
# Then we can plot the network
string_db$plot_network(ct_genes_mapped$STRING_id)
write.table(ct_genes, "~/core_genes_diff_expr_in_cell_types.tsv", sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, echo = F}
prs <- res[rownames(res)[rownames(res) %in% usp24_exons], ]
prs <- t(t(as.data.frame(prs)))
colnames(prs) <- "USP24_SCZ"
plot_data <- merge(pheno, prs, by.x = "ShortName", by.y = "row.names")

# generate scatterplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = USP24_SCZ, y = PRS.SCZ2, col = Dx)) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  xlab("USP24 exon expression (residuals)") + 
  ylab("SCZ2-2014 polygenic risk score (PRS)") + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(9, 3)], name = "Diagnosis", labels = c("Controls", "Cases"))
ggsave(file = paste0(out_path, "/3_scatterplot_USP24_exon_expr_vs_SCZ2_PRS.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
```
